incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated 5xx and p99 timeouts observed for gateway-service in prod (svc=gateway-prod) after deployment 2026-03-14T02:17Z. p95 -> 700ms, p99 -> 18s, 5xx rate up ~8%. Dashboard: https://datadog.internal/redwood/dashboard/gateway-prod
Priya M: ack I'm on it, taking pager. pulling traces and logs now
Ajay P: which canary/commit? I see a small deploy at 02:17 that changed nginx upstream keepalive settings in the ingress config. Could be connection reuse change.
Sam L: logs: nginx error.log shows repeated "upstream prematurely closed connection" and "connect() to 10.0.4.12:8080 failed (111: Connection refused)" across many workers. Looks like upstreams are hitting max idle/keepalive exhaustion and causing long queueing.
Priya M: running quick healthcheck and curling the health endpoint
oncall-sre: ```
curl -v https://gateway.prod.internal/health
# output: HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n{"status":"ok"} (but higher latencies for proxied requests)
```
Ajay P: check pods and connection counts on runtime pool (runtime-app replicas). I want `ss` to see TIME_WAIT/ESTAB.
oncall-sre: ```
kubectl exec -c runtime runtime-app-3 -- ss -s
Total: 2420 (kernel 0)
TCP:   1500 established, 900 timewait, 20 closed\n# conntrack also shows high count
```
Maria C: quick question — are requests getting queued at the ingress or timing out at runtime? Traces show requests stuck ~12-18s before returning 502.
Ajay P: likely ingress is holding connections while backend rejects. p99 latency spike = connection reuse + backend transient refusal. I think the ingress change to `keepalive_timeout` and `keepalive_requests` in the last config caused upstreams to be reused longer and exhaust pool under burst.
Priya M: impact estimate? support needs numbers.
Ajay P: from SLO dashboard: ~8% of requests in last 5m returned 5xx, user-facing error rate for API routes is ~6.5%. For a high-volume customer cohort it's ~12% during the window. Some customers reported failed inference calls (timeouts).
support-bot: logging customer-impact note: "Multiple inference calls failing with 502/timeouts; customers A,B,C may be affected."
Priya M: can we mitigate without rollback? Suggestions: increase runtime replica count, drain and warm new pods, or change ingress keepalive back. Which is fastest?
Sam L: quick mitigation path = revert ingress config; it's a single managed k8s configmap change -> rollout to ingress controller. That should restore previous connection behavior immediately. If revert risky, we can scale runtime replicas x2 but warmup takes time and could increase cost.
Maria C: rollback ingress config is lowest blast radius. I support revert + monitor.
Ajay P: agree. I'll prepare the manifest and run the rollback.
Ajay P: ```
# rollback command (ingress configmap)
kubectl -n infra set data configmap/ingress-config --from-file=ingress.conf=/deployments/ingress/ingress.conf.previous
kubectl rollout restart deployment/nginx-ingress-controller -n infra
```
Priya M: initiating rollback now. tagging the change in the incident log. (starting at 1849992305)
incident-bot: Rollback started by Priya M at 1849992305. Rolling back ingress-config to previous commit sha: a1b2c3d4.
Priya M: also unblocking a quick canary: I'll patch nginx to drain gracefully, restart 1 replica at a time.
Ajay P: running lightweight smoke tests against a few endpoints.
Ajay P: ```
# quick smoke
for u in /v1/generate /v1/embeddings; do curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://gateway.prod.internal$u -o /dev/null; done
# before rollback: 502 18.452\n# after rollback (expected): 200 0.128
```
support-bot: adding customer comms draft to incident doc: "We're investigating transient errors impacting some API requests; mitigation in progress, we'll update in 15m."
Priya M: rollback finished, ingress pods restarted and warm. Monitoring. (finished at 1849992380) :thumbsup:
Sam L: metrics updating — 5xx rate dropping. p95 back to ~180ms, p99 trending down from 18s -> 220ms in last 2m.
Ajay P: datadog query snippet: ```
avg(last_5m):percentile(request.duration,95) by {service}
# shows clear drop at 1849992385
```
Maria C: rechecking traces — connection errors gone, upstream 502s replaced by 200s. For safety, I'm keeping the request rate limited for 10 more minutes to avoid thrashing.
Priya M: customer impact summary for post-incident: start 1849992170, mitigation completed 1849992380. Peak error rate ~8%, affected customers small subset; transient inference failures reported. Preparing postmortem and RCA.
Ajay P: suggested root cause: ingress keepalive config changes led to connection reuse patterns that didn't play well with runtime's connection handling under burst. Action items: revert default keepalive changes, add load-test for ingress config permutations, add a canary gating step in config rollout, and alert on keepalive connection saturation.
Maria C: assigned postmortem to Ajay + Priya, support to follow up with impacted customers.
oncall-sre: closing the pager, leaving handoff notes in #incidents-postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "mitigated" state. Please file postmortem within 48h. :white_check_mark:
Priya M: thanks everyone — will round up logs and add timeline.
support-bot: queued follow-up comms to customers A,B,C to confirm recovery.
Maria C: adding retrospective item: better preflight for ingress config changes and automated rollback if p99>2s within 3 minutes of rollout.
Priya M: end of thread.
